summary:
Hoax bomb threats disrupted dozens of flights across Europe this week, with at least 34 affected by one count and at least 35 planes searched or diverted by another. Some planes were forced into emergency landings. Security inspections found no explosives, and the EU transport commissioner said it was "too early" to say whether threats to 20 flights are linked.

California Governor Gavin Newsom said on Thursday, November 5, that he is commuting all death sentences in the state to life imprisonment. He called capital punishment "incompatible" with California's values. California has historically had the largest death row population in the US, and the number of affected prisoners is more than 500 in one account and 548 in another.

Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigned on Thursday after the collapse of Ueno Bank froze millions of people's savings and plunged the country into a political crisis. He had apologised for failing to prevent the country's worst financial crisis in decades, and the lower house of congress had voted to pursue an impeachment trial against him.

Security inspections found no explosives, and the EU transport commissioner said it was "too early" to say whether threats to 20 flights are linked.

headlines.title: California to commute all death sentences to life imprisonment
headlines.summary: Governor Gavin Newsom said on Thursday that he is commuting all death sentences in California to life imprisonment, calling capital punishment "incompatible" with state values. One account puts the number of affected prisoners above 500, another at 548.

headlines.title: Paraguay's president Santiago Peña resigns after bank collapse
headlines.summary: Paraguay's President Santiago Peña resigned on Thursday after the Ueno Bank collapse froze millions of people's savings. The move followed a vote by the lower house of congress to pursue an impeachment trial against him.

headlines.title: Bank of England raises interest rates for first time since 2023
headlines.summary: The Bank of England raised its interest rate for the first time since 2023, saying inflation pressure from months of high energy prices required a rise now. Policymakers warned that a further rise is more likely.

headlines.title: Herzog to name candidate to form Israeli government on Sunday
headlines.summary: President Isaac Herzog will announce on Sunday, November 8, whom he will task with forming a new government. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been endorsed by 67 lawmakers, while 46 recommended Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

headlines.title: Protests over cost of living spread across France
headlines.summary: Hundreds of demonstrations took place across France on Thursday over the high cost of living. The interior ministry estimated 600,000 people joined, while unions said the number was far higher.

headlines.title: Tech stocks tumble over fears of US AI curbs after midterms
headlines.summary: Global tech stocks fell after the US midterm elections, with the Nasdaq dropping more than 5% and about $2 trillion wiped from tech shares. Investors feared a Democratic Congress and states would crack down on AI and data centres.

headlines.title: Bus carrying schoolchildren crashes in France, two dead
headlines.summary: A bus carrying children to middle and high schools crashed in France, leaving 2 dead and 16 injured, BFM TV reported. The bus veered off the road, and Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot was on his way to the scene.
